g.text: Realtime Connector: строго один event до terminal acceptance
backoff; same key; do not read next
Queue expiry, missing heartbeat, restart или web_reload_client
повторяют единый bootstrap с новой queue/boundary.
Bridge не делает fan-out/projections и не доставляет WebSocket.
Duplicate/no-op не создаёт outbox или public event.
Last confirmed wins; origin/causation suppresses echo only.
mTLS authenticates Bridge; lease separately authorizes account ownership.
